description: This Java source file defines the EventScheduler class, which manages scheduling and execution of timed events using a timestamped buffer. It includes nested classes for event representation (SchedulableEvent) and a custom queue (FastEventQueue). The class manages thread-safe operations for adding, removing, and retrieving scheduled events, supporting real-time MIDI event scheduling.

classes.name: EventScheduler
classes.description: Main class managing scheduled events with timestamp ordering and thread-safe access.

classes.name: EventScheduler.SchedulableEvent
classes.description: Base class representing a schedulable event with a timestamp.

classes.name: EventScheduler.FastEventQueue
classes.description: Inner class implementing a thread-safe queue for events, optimized for concurrent access.

methods.name: removeEventfromPool

methods.name: addEventToPool
methods.description: Returns an event to the pool for reuse, preventing unbounded memory growth.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an event to the scheduler in a thread-safe manner, maintaining timestamp order.

methods.name: getNextEvent
methods.description: Checks if there are any events ready to be processed based on the specified time.

methods.name: waitNextEvent
methods.description: Waits until the next scheduled event is ready, using System.nanoTime() for timing.
